submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm achieves the best pion/kaon separation (4.47 sigma) at 10 GeV/c according to the latest simulations. Performance decreases for greater thickness, and lower thicknesses also yield lower separation. Documentation and the experimental environment do not indicate lifetime or stability issues for this radiator. All constraints (allowed options, thickness, and size) are met.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 is one of the listed candidates.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: No documentation or meeting notes indicate durability or lifetime concerns for Radiator-R2. The vessel is flushed with dry nitrogen, favoring stable operation.
Selected thickness is 3 cm, within the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 at 3 cm delivers the best simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c (4.47 sigma), outperforming all other candidates and thicknesses.
